versions.localizedDescription:
Orivio TV v0.17

Sideload both files the usual way: Sideload.ipa installs alongside an existing Orivio with its own data, Sideloadly.ipa updates an existing sideloaded install in place.

What's new

🗑️ Remove from Continue Watching works right away, every time.
- Removing a title used to take up to 2 minutes to show, because Home only noticed on the next sync. It now disappears the moment you press Remove.
- After removing a few titles, the rest sometimes wouldn't remove at all, mainly "Next Up" episodes. Fixed.
- Removed titles stay removed. A sync from Trakt or another device could quietly...

What's New in 3.3.0

This is a big one. Four months of work since 3.2.1 covering iCloud sync, a completely revamped tvOS interface, video filters, and a ton of core and stability fixes.

☁️ iCloud / CloudKit Sync
- ROMs, save states, BIOS files, and artwork now sync across devices via iCloud
- Real-time download progress indicators when loading cloud save states
- Auto BIOS sync on game load when available in iCloud
- ROM metadata syncs alongside files
- Artwork syncs after library updates
- CloudKit records management tab in Settings
- iCloud upsell UI for new users with empty libraries
-...
